macros.name: ddDimens
macros.doc: \ddDimens sets up the dimensions of the stamps and the push buttons.

macros.name: ddGameIcon
macros.doc: \ddGameIcon is a command that sets up the positioning of the stamps, the argument of this command is the name of the stamp to be used.

macros.name: ddReset
macros.doc: \ddReset is a reset button. It puts the stamps back into their initial positions, and returns the push buttons to their original appearance.

macros.name: ddTargetFmt
macros.doc: Use the command \ddTargetFmt to set the formatting (or styling) of the captions, it takes one argument which is passed to the tex stream prior to the caption.

macros.name: ddTargetOfIcon
macros.doc: This command creates a target push button.

macros.name: initDDGame
macros.doc: \initDDGame initializes the DAD game, each game must have a unique name.
